tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gtor bsngo brgya rtsa sogs byed pa'i phyag len 'dod don lhun grub bzhugs so// swa sti/ rgyal kun rgyal bstan bsrung ba'i phyir/ /'jigs rung 'jigs pa'i skur bzhengs nas/ /bstan dang bstan 'dzin skyong mdzad rnams/ /mnyes rab mnyes pa'i thabs 'di spel/ /'dir gur zhal sogs chos skyong srung ma rnams la gtor bsngo brgya rtsa byed pa la/ lag len dngos dang phan yon bshad pa'o/ /dang po la sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ sbyor ba yi dam chos skyong sogs kyi rten drung du gtor ma lnga tshar sogs gang dgos bdud rtsi ril bu dang / nyi zla nor bus rgyan pa dang / chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod bsham/ rnal 'byor pa rang rten la kha phyogs pa'i mdun du rdo dril nang mchod me tog rnams bsham/ bdag bskyed ni bde kye phur gsum sogs bla med kyi yi dam gang rung gi mchog mod/ deng sang phyag len la kyai rdor lam dus thun gsum thun gnyis gang bde mdzad/ de ltar thugs dam grub nas gtor ma rnams nang mchod chu chang gis sbyang / dam pa 'ga' zhig gi phyag len la mchod pa byin rlabs re yang mdzad 'dug phal che ba ni mi mdzad 'dug pas gang mos bya'o/ /gtor ma byin rlabs rgyas par byas nas yi dam la phul zhing kun 'grub shog gi bar 'dra/ de nas rgyas par na mdun du cog tse sogs kyi steng du gtor theb gnyis su cog gtor re dang gzhan spo rgyu cog gtor sogs bshams te/ mgon po'i gtor ma nang mchod ltar byin brlab rgyas par byas/ mdun gyi nam mkha'i gnas su paṃ las sogs nas rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod kyi bar tshar gcig dang / gtor ma gnyis bsham pa'i gcig nang mchod sogs kyis sbyangs/ gtor ma nang mchod ltar rgyas par byin gyis brlabs/ gtor ma oṃ shrī mahā kā la sa pā ri wa ra sogs nas 'phrin las mdzod kyi bar dang / gtor ma de bsdus/ yang gnyis pa nang mchod sogs nas snga ma ltar mdzod kyi bar gyis phul/

de lta bu nyin re la nyi shu rtsa gcig la sogs pa gang 'gro bya/ zhal dang las mgon sogs la'ang de'i rigs 'gres sbyar/ gzhan lhag ma rnams rjes chog gi bar dkyus ma bzhin bya'o/ /yang na thog mar mgon chen la brgya rtsa bsags/ de nas rim bzhin bsags kyang rung bas stabs gang bde byas mchog bstod pa phal cher sngar bzhin las skabs skabs su bstod pa/ gsar rnying bstod 'bum sogs nas sh+lo ka gcig gnyis gang zin re mdzad/ stabs ma bde na dkyus kyis mchog de ltar gtor ma spos pa'i sgo nas brgya tshar 'bul lugs rgyas pa'o// ༈ /'bring du byed na brgya rtsa bsog pa'i lnga tshar lhag po tshar gcig bsham ste/ gtor bsngo tshar gcig bzlas pa bshags pa dang bcas sngar bzhin bya/ de nas bsog pa'i lnga tshar la mtheb skyu gnyis re gsos nang mchod chu chang gis sbyangs/ byin rlabs rgyas pa tshar gcig gis mtheb skyu bcu ka byin brlabs dus gcig la byas te bstod pa'i bar lan bcu re 'bul zhing / rjes ma rnams oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥyis lag pa g.yon g.yas gnyis ka bya khyung gi phyag rgya dang bcas bstan ste/ sngags de nyid lan gsum tsam brjod pas sngar gyi byin brlab dran par byas te 'bul/ de lta bu bcu tshan bcu dang / slar yang mtheb skyu brgyad pa gcig ste brgya rtsa re 'bul/ 'di la yang nyin re bzhin mgon chen zhal bzhi las mgon rnams grangs mnyam byas nas cig car 'gro bar byed dam/ yang thog mar mgon chen la brgya tshar/ de nas rim gyis bsog pa gang bde bya'o// ༈ /bsdu na lnga tshar gyis mgon chen la sogs pa'i rang rang gi gtor ma la mtheb skyu bcu res gsos kyi byin gyis brlab nas 'bul tshul sngar bzhin no/ /gzhan rjes chog sogs 'dra'o// ༈ /gnyis pa de ltar byas pa'i phan yon sogs 'di ltar nges par bya ste/ dbang thob dam tshig ldan pa yis/ /chos skyong rjes gnang lung bcas thob/ /kyai rdo rje'i gzhi gnyen sogs/

/sngon du song ba'i rnal 'byor pas/ /'di lta'i cho gar brtson byas na/ /'dod don lhun gyis grub par 'gyur/ /lung rigs man ngag nges 'byed rnams/ /yi ges 'jigs phyir ma bris shing / /shes par 'dod na ngag las longs/ /'di ni don gnyer du ma yis/ /snga phyir yang yang bskul ba'i ngor/ /phyogs med ris med bya bral ba/ /sangs rgyas phun tshogs gang des so/ /nongs na mkhas rnams bzod par bzhes/ /dge bas rang gzhan 'gro ba kun/ /'dod don lhun gyis grub par shog /'di'i rigs 'gres chos skyong gzhan la 'bul na'ang shes par bya'o/ /'di yang sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis so// //shu bhaṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ gtor bsngo brgya rtsa sogs byed pa'i phyag len 'dod don lhun grub/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
